topography.project_purpose: Harvest Finance is an auto-compounding yield aggregator that routes user deposits into yield-generating strategies and compounds returns. It operates across multiple chains, offering vaults that optimize yields from various DeFi protocols.
topography.relationship_narrative: The Controller manages vault and strategy registration, while RewardToken distributes FARM incentives. Vaults and strategies are linked via proxies, with strategies implementing yield generation and vaults handling deposits and compounding.
